title: 第15章 毕竟是白送的嘛第16章 那个喜好男生的队长
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
“就是那种可以生很多小孩子的媳妇！就算打骂也绝对不会哭的很乖的媳妇！养两年就可以结婚的媳妇！你缺吗？！”
林恩愕然道：
“干什么？！”
花耶o（≧口≦）o道：
“如果你缺的话，那只要你能送花耶回家，花耶就给你当小媳妇！你要吗？！”
林恩：“？！！！”
“……”
许久，林恩犹疑地看着她，道：
“你确定？”
花耶瞪着眼，吞咽道：“确……确定……吧……”
毕竟已经没有办法了，在这种情况之下，被留在这里肯定是会被杀的，红月降临的情况之下，灵界当中的那些怪物也会更加的危险。
不要说再来一次刚才那样的袭击了，就算只是随便来一只恶灵，她也绝对是扛不住的！
o（╥﹏╥）o
林恩想了想。
买卖萝莉吗？
额……
如果想一想的话，这好像的确是是一个无本万利的提议呢。
毕竟只要做个护送任务，就可以白嫖媳妇一枚，不管怎么想都感觉血赚不亏的啊。
而且既然好不容易重新做人，那想要正常而合法地融入到人类社会当中，那有一个媳妇应该也是非常正常的一件事情吧。
林恩犹疑地伸出手。

戳了戳。
嗯。
虽然呆了一点，小了一点，没用了一点，但似乎也的确是一个可以成为妻子的合适的人选呢。
毕竟是白送的嘛……
但林恩很快一怔，摇了摇头，捏着下巴沉思了起来。
不行的吧！
怎么想都不行的吧！
虽然这好像的确是一个非常好的提议，但是这要是被人看到的话，很容易就会被当成是万恶的萝莉控给处决的吧！
毕竟他从不控什么东西……
“会做饭吗？”
花耶瞪眼道：“会吃饭！”
“会洗衣服吗？”
花耶瞪眼道：“会买衣服！”
啊！（o?▽?）o果然是一只非常没用的萝莉呢！
这要是带回去不会还得自己花钱养吧！但拉出去接客又有些太过于浪费，这无论怎么想都是一笔……
“成交。”
“诶？？”
林恩严肃地伸出了手和她握了握。
毕竟一本万利的买卖，不做白不做。
……

几分钟之后。
花耶o（╥﹏╥）o地坐在那里，拿着笔极度不情愿写下了一份卖身契。
然后被林恩抓着小手，沾了一点那个怪物黏糊糊的血，在上面摁了一个大大的手印。
啪——
content_en:
"She is the kind of wife who can give birth to many children! A well-behaved wife who will never cry even if she is beaten and scolded! A wife who can get married in two years! Are you in need?!"
Lin En said in astonishment:
"What?!"
Huaye (≧口≦) said:
"If you are in need, then as long as you can send Huaye home, Huaye will be your little wife! Do you want it?!"
Lynn: "?!!!"
"..."
For a long time, Lin En looked at her hesitantly and said:
"Are you sure?"
Hua Ye stared and swallowed: "Yes... sure..."
After all, there is no other way. Under this situation, if you are left here, you will definitely be killed. With the red moon coming, the monsters in the spirit world will be even more dangerous.
Not to mention another attack like that just now, even if it was just a random evil spirit, she would definitely not be able to withstand it!
o（╥﹏╥）o
Lynn thought for a moment.
Buying and selling lolita?
Um...
If you think about it, this seems to be a costless proposition.
After all, as long as you do an escort mission, you can get your wife for free. No matter how you think about it, it feels like you are well earned.
And since it's hard to be a new person, it should be very normal to have a daughter-in-law if you want to integrate into human society normally and legally.
Linn held out his hand hesitantly.
Poke.
Um.
Although she is a little older, a little smaller, and a little useless, she does seem to be a suitable candidate to become a wife.
After all, it was given for free...
But Linn was quickly startled, shook his head, held his chin and began to think deeply.
No way!
No matter how you think about it, it won’t work!
Although this seems to be a very good proposal, if someone sees this, it will easily be regarded as an evil lolita and executed!
After all, he never controls anything...
"Can you cook?"
Hua Ye glared and said, "I know how to eat!"
"Can you do laundry?"
Hua Ye glared and said, "I know how to buy clothes!"
Ah! (o?▽?)o is indeed a very useless loli!
If you take this back, you won’t have to spend money to support it yourself! But it’s a bit too wasteful to go out to pick up customers. No matter how you think about it, it’s a fortune...
"Deal."
"Eh??"
Linn reached out his hand and shook hers seriously.
After all, a profitable business is not done in vain.
…
After a few minutes.
Huaye sat there in a daze (╥﹏╥), holding a pen and writing a deed of sale with great reluctance.
Then Lin En grabbed his little hand, dipped it in some of the monster's sticky blood, and put a big handprint on it.
Snap——
